meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装上只读网页仪表盘 clidash:它读取能输出 JSON 的 CLI(如 ncl),运行时自动为每个资源生成一个标签页和表格。另带消息活动图表、日志尾部和一个只读文件查看器(群组技能、CLAUDE.md、profiles)。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 clidash 只读仪表盘,或想用浏览器查看 ncl 的 groups、sessions 等资源时触发。

howto.what_en: Installs clidash, a read-only web dashboard. Pointed at any CLI that lists resources as JSON (such as ncl), it builds one tab per resource plus a generic table at runtime, along with message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add the clidash read-only dashboard to NanoClaw, or want to view ncl resources such as groups and sessions as web tables.

say_en.text: Install the clidash read-only dashboard for NanoClaw
say_en.note: copies tools/clidash and creates the config

say_en.text: Start clidash so I can see ncl resource tables in a browser
Run clidash as a systemd user service bound to 127.0.0.1
say_en.note: sets the bind address via BIND
